note: Convoy cargo load cooked from the gate-2-approved TRELLIS candidate hd-s505 (reviews/gate2-decision.json). Box-fitted into the convoy's open rear bed (interior x +-0.60, y 0.50-1.40, floor 0.88 m, walls to 1.28 m); the convoy places it at socket-cargo. No ground-sheet removal: the flat double-layer base lies inside the crate footprint and is hidden on the bed floor.

normalize.note: Uniform scale to fit the bed interior with about 2 cm clearance; the pile's long side (crates plus the barrel) runs across the wagon (X). Measured: 0.94 x 0.86 x 0.64 m, limited by Y.

regions.name: iron
regions.note: Above the hidden underside, which TRELLIS invented dark.

body.provenance: Base colour re-baked (Cycles CPU, emission, selected-to-active) from the approved TRELLIS source mesh onto fresh smart-projected UVs (the 229k-triangle source atlas does not survive a 98% decimation); no ground-sheet removal and no rear-view projection, so the second row of crates, the back and the underside are as TRELLIS invented them. Tangent normals baked from the source geometry and whiteout-blended with colour relief (rope and sack folds survive mainly there); AO baked from the decimated geometry; roughness and metalness derived from colour inside declared regions (dark, unsaturated iron corner brackets; the saturated ochre hide on top); no tone lift. Base alpha opaque (never dyed). Artistic derivation, not measured PBR.
